en.reinstallHint: Download and atomically replace the runner binary (does not affect the live connection; reconnects automatically when done)
en.connectHint: Opens an SSH session and runs the runner inside it (the pipe owns its lifetime).
en.connectTimeout: Timed out waiting for the runner to connect
en.connectionModeHint: tunnel: the machine needs no route to the server (ssh -R). direct: the runner dials the server itself.
en.disconnectHint: Closes the SSH pipe and kills the runner on the machine.
en.reconnectHint: Kills the current runner and starts a new one.
en.confirmInstall: Install xbot-runner on this machine now?
en.empty: No machines yet — add one with an SSH command.
en.errorDuplicate: A machine with this name already exists
en.provisionRunningHint: Downloading and installing on the remote machine — this can take a while. Keep this panel open.
en.sessionNotReady: Session not ready yet — open a chat first
en.switchLocalHint: Run tools on this server again
en.manifest.name: Remote Machines (SSH)
en.manifest.description: Onboard remote machines with a single SSH command: probe the environment, auto-install and start xbot-runner, then use the machine as a switchable execution target for sessions. Control-plane plugin (stdio); execution still runs over the existing runner WebSocket protocol.
en.view.panel.title: Remote Machines
en.view.bar.title: Remote Machines (bar)
en.config.downloadBase.label: Runner download base URL
en.config.downloadBase.description: Download base for the xbot-runner binary and checksums.txt (defaults to this project's GitHub Release latest/download; point it at a mirror if needed).
en.config.installDir.label: Remote install directory
en.config.installDir.description: Directory the runner binary is installed into (for non-root users ~/.local/bin is recommended).
en.config.serviceMode.label: Service mode
en.config.serviceMode.description: systemd user unit (recommended) or a nohup fallback for minimal systems without systemd.
en.config.targets.label: Onboarded targets (JSON, maintained by the panel)
en.config.targets.description: Machine target registry: [{name, ssh, install_dir, service_mode, added_at}]. Hosted by the server and visible across devices.
